comment.body:
Thanks for reporting this on the Store build and for the follow-up that it also failed on 0.88. Current source has context-menu registration paths, so the remaining question is whether today’s Store package is still affected. Please confirm:
1. The current PowerToys version and install source.
2. Whether the entry is missing from both the modern Explorer menu and Show more options, or only one.
This distinguishes package registration from menu-surface behavior. No logs are needed.
